It’s yet another day in Petrichoria.
I love this town, I really do. It’s just... Sometimes the days feel... Monotonous.
Get up, get dressed, grab the mail from the front door.
Then I head to the inn.
Fine, you win. What am I having for breakfast?
Pie.
Pie?
Pie. You can carry them with you. Take 4. Eat one now while I’m watching. Eat the rest as you do your deliveries.
Yana... That’s too much.
Nonsense, uso. Take them.
Okay, fine. But take your mail so I have room for them.
Give it here.
Yana... I think I would be fine with 1.
Nonsense, uso. You don’t eat enough. Take all 4 and give me my mail.
Okay, fine. I know better than to argue with you. Here is your mail.
Thank you. Now shoo. Go get your work done so you can rest.

Fortunately, everyone is pretty close by so delivering their mail doesn’t take too long. My next stop is to see Rin at the Library. I have a couple of books that Rin ordered and I’m sure they’ll be happy to get them

Deliveries have been taking longer and longer to get to us since we lost Esben. People are less interested in coming to our town for longer than it takes to get from our docks to the road back to Cidal.
Yana makes the most incredible food but that’s not the most magical thing about her.
How does she get up before everyone and stay up later than everyone?
The Inn is never closed. There’s always food ready. That’s the real magic.
Yana, I have your mail for you.
I won’t accept that until you’ve eaten, Opal. You’re turning into your mother.
What’s that supposed to mean?
You work too much, uso. Eat first. Work comes later.
Here. Take these pies. You can eat one now and have some later.
Of course, uso! How much time do you have?
Not a lot. Some time sensitive things to deliver today.
Yana tell me you have something delicious for me today.
I have your books for you!
Not a chance. You know as well as I do that he loves Diora and Meriko more than he could ever love the ocean. I think he just wants to take them both out on an adventure, but Meriko gets so sea sick.
She’s such an odd one. Really good at making a distraction in a pinch, though.
Don’t I know it. I’ve used her skills more than once to duck out of an awkward conversation with your mother.
Haven’t we all. What’s next?
Diora ordered Advanced Weaving Techniques. Rumour has it that she’s going to try her hand at weaving some complex fabric for a gown. I wonder if she’s applying to that fashion show again.
Wasn’t she rejected last year because her designs were “too colourful” for the all-mighty fashionistas of Dalo?
There’s no reasoning with her. Thank you, Rin.
Dalo is as colourful as it is fun. Which is to say, it’s neither. All white-washed stones and straight edges...
Can’t feel the earth beneath your feet. I hope she doesn’t let it change the way she designs. Her garments are beautiful.
Everyone in Dalo could learn a thing or two from her. Speaking of town fashionistas, what do you have for Eriato?

Letting Go: A Guide to Organizing. I don’t know why he keeps doing this to himself. You know just as well as I do that he can’t let go of anything. I’m pretty sure his house is just every “phase” he’s ever had in various corners.
Eriato is a lot of things but a quitter is never one of them. That includes giving up any of his past phases and admitting he’s grown out of them.
We love him, even if he’s a bit… much. And last, but certainly not least, for my love Kauma. She’s still trying to find a cure to the blight. She’s ordered yet another biology textbook.
I’m pretty sure she has this one already but she can’t find it. If you’d ever seen the inside of her home office, you’d know why.
You could help her find it and keep this one in the library?
And touch her “organized chaos?” No, thank you. I would like to keep all of my limbs attached and not used for kindling.
If you could just bring her this copy of Kairithian Biology: Advanced Medical Text for the Modern Age, I (and my limbs) would greatly appreciate it.
Anything for you, Rin.
Ah, if it isn’t my favourite sentence to hear at the start of my day. Which ones have come in?
I’m not sure. They all came bundled together and I didn’t dare deprive you of the joy of opening that package.
You’re the best, Ope. Let me see what we have.

Oh now this is exciting. It’s a mix of books I ordered for the library and books I ordered for Kauma, Diora, Arecho, and Eriato. You wouldn’t mind delivering these to them, since they’re on your route, would you?
Anything for my favourite Spriggan. What am I delivering?
You’re truly the brightest gem in this whole jade forest.

So this one, Tacks, Clips, and Scurvy: A Sailor’s Lament, is for Arecho but Diora ordered it as a surprise. She noticed he’s been looking longingly at the water again and she thinks he’s missing sailing.
Of course, of course. What is it this time?
Your mother’s latest romance book was just checked back in. In Defense of Love Potions.
Got it, I’ll set that at the bottom of my bag so no one sees it.
The mention of Jade makes my heart ache, but I smile and wait for the list.
She could just... Come in and get it but you know how she is.
My mother’s love of romance books is the worst kept secret in Petrichoria, but everyone in town pretends they don’t know.
Do you think he’d ever go back?
Just the you-know-what for you-know-who.
You got anything you need me to pick up?
Good Morning Rin!
I always enjoy our chats, Rin. I have to get going to my other deliveries.
Go soak up some sun for me.
Good morning Eri!
Oh if it isn’t the most delightful sight for my poorly rested eyes.
Poorly rested? How much sleep did you get last night?
I only slept for 10 hours. Honestly I had the worst time getting up this morning. Tell me you have something to brighten my day, my iridescent little friend.
As a matter of fact, I do. Here are this month’s fashion catalogues from Dalo and Rin asked me to deliver this copy of Letting Go: A Guide to Organizing that you’d ordered.
Oh they do listen to me so well. Did they happen to tell you that I’m planning to follow Zari Bandoo’s lifestyle guides on decluttering?
They did mention that, yes.
Why do you look so skeptical, my dear.
Eriato... My good friend... When was the last time you actually parted with an article of clothing?
Well... Never but that’s not the point. I’m turning over a new wing, so to speak.
And why are you doing that?
Saoirse is refusing to add another room to my house. She said it’s a “waste of resources.”
Ah. Now I understand. Well, I wish you the best of luck. I have to finish up my deliveries, unless you have anything you need me to take?
Saoirse is refusing to add another room to my house. She said it’s a “waste of resources.”
No. The only order I have was from Telu and that’s one delivery I don’t mind making myself.
Good morning Kauma!
Kauma?
Hmm… I don’t think she’s here.
Usually she’s either at her desk or in Bella’s pen, but she’s not at her desk.
Hmm... She’s not in here either.
Kauma! I’m leaving these here on your desk!
Kauma?!?
Oh! Give me a moment!
It’s Opal! I’m here to deliver the mail!
Who’s here?
Is... Is that what the crash was?
Hi. Sorry. I was trying a new potion upstairs and I didn’t hear anyone come in.
Rin asked me to deliver this copy of Kairithian Biology: Advanced Medical Text for the Modern Age and this package of supplies arrived for you this morning.
The crash was me being unsuccessful in trying a new potion upstairs. What do you have for me?
Oh that is fantastic news. Thank you, Opal. Not to be rude but I have to get back upstairs before my problems become an entire Petrichoria problem.
Kauma! I’m leaving these here on your desk!
Mornin’, Opal! What yuh bringin’ me today, girl?
Rin sent the two books you ordered, and there are some letters from Dalo and Calirie. I’m guessing they’re orders?
Ah yes, I sent out that catalogue ‘bout six months ago to all the capitals. Nuff people hadda get dey hands on it. Thank yuh, Opal.
And here he said he was trying to make space.
For all the clothes he’s orderin'? Pfft, nah, space ain’t ever enough for him. He goin’ need a whole new room just for all the things he’s got on the way.
Eriato ALWAYS orderin' clothes, yuh know?
Well, if these orders don’t pile up too high, that’s the plan. But y’know how it is, eh? Always somethin’ to fix.
I’ll leave you to it then, unless you need me to deliver anything for you today?
Nah, nah, not today. I just need to fix up some seams on these garments. But tomorrow, I’ll need yuh to help me deliver these clothes to Eriato and Yana.
I heard a little rumour that you’re trying your hand at making some fancy fabrics now?
Eriato ordered more clothes?
Sounds like Telu is busy at work.
But my ears still work.
Good morning, Telu.
Kia ora, Opal. How goes?
You know, same old same old. Just doing my deliveries.
And I assume that means you have something for me?
That I do. I have some letters from Zagalla and from Vrezodia.
Watching the hurt on his face every time I deliver letters from Lyrei’s family never gets any easier but he masks it well.
I think I’ll do just that, then.
Nah. Just passing time until Effie is out of school.
I need to do the same. Tivona is last on my list of deliveries and I have no desire to interrupt class.
Why don’t you take a break? There’s a path that goes through there that has some interesting sights.
You wouldn’t mind me cutting through your lumberyard?
As long as you don’t cut too close to the grove and you don’t hurt the trees, it’s a lovely little walk.
Cheers. If you could just set them on the bench over there, I’ll take them home when I’m done here.
Long day ahead?
Telu was right. This is a lovely walk. The sunlight filtering through the trees is beautiful this time of year.
I’m not sure what he meant about interesting sights, though. Everything so far just looks like...
What is that?
Is that… A MAILBOX?

Who could even be getting mail all the way out here? Who would be delivering mail?

I don’t see any houses or people anywhere nearby.
Hmm... Is... Is that rocks? And... Sticks? And a leaf. Fascinating. I’m just gonna leave that there.
What is making all that noise?
Are... Are those walking mushrooms?!
Um hello?
Wait! I...
Hm. That’s not going to work. What if I just...
There. Now we’re the same size... Okay not quite but close enough.
Hey little guys. Is that your mailbox?
M A I L ?
I don’t think they understand me. Maybe I need to show them some mail?
Like this.
Anyway...
I’m not sure where I’ll put this but they clearly want to be part of the mail system and who am I to tell them they can’t be?
Oh. No. I’m sorry. This is for someone else.
Aaaaaaaaaand they’re gone. Hm… What a strange bunch of creatures.
Mmmmmmmmm?
Did you have a good walk?
Have you seen them?
Seen who?
The little walking mushrooms.
Aye cuz. That was some walk you had.
Telu, I’m serious. There’s little walking mushrooms out there.
Yeah. I’m heading over there myself to pick up Effie. Want me to walk with you and you can tell me more about these uh... Walking mushroom?
Yeah, nah. I have no idea what you’re talking about, Ope.
Nevermind. I have to finish up my deliveries. School should be out soon, yeah?
Please don’t forget to practice your writing!
Effie!
Hi, Dad.
Opal was just telling me the craziest story.
Oh?
Yes, actually. I have some more notebooks that were delivered and a box of wax sticks.
Fantastic. Thank you. Now, tell me more about these walking mushrooms?
They seemed... Like they wanted to learn? But they were so scared. I tried to talk to them and they ran away.
Well, Opal, if no one’s ever seen them then they must not be around higher fey very often.
They clearly watch us if they made their own mailbox. It was a really well made mailbox, too. Weird but well made.
Fascinating. Hm... Okay. Well let me know if you see them again.
I will. I’m off to do my final delivery.
Oh? Who is left?
My mother.
Ah. Good luck with that. I’ll see you later?
Not tonight. It’s our weekly dinner.
Oh my. Okay. Well good luck with THAT.
It wasn’t a crazy story. I followed a path that your dad sent me down and I happened upon a bunch of walking mushrooms.
You’ve seen them too!?
See? I told you I wasn’t hallucinating.
Walking mushrooms?
Yes. They had a mailbox and everything.
A... Mailbox?
Yes. A mailbox. Though, admittedly their understanding of mail is... Well... They don’t understand it at all, really.
The mailbox with feet?
Yes! The weird mailbox out there in the middle of the forest.
I was too scared to look in it when I went over there.
You went over there?
Okay I feel like you’re focusing on the wrong part of this.
Okay, we’re leaving. We need to go home and have a talk about not wandering into the forest.
Remind her to practice her writing, please.
Did you have anything for me today, Opal?
Mom, I have your mail for you.
Anything interesting?
A couple letters from Dalo and a delivery from Rin.
Leave them on my desk. Tomorrow try to be a little more timely with the deliveries. It’s almost dinner time.
Actually, it wasn’t that interesting. I’ll see you at dinner.
Well, actually, something really interesting happened.
Opal, I don’t have time to hear about this right now. Just tell me over dinner.
Hmm... Where to put these? This basket will do, I guess, for now.
The Next Morning in the Town Hall
Time to start my deliveries for the day. Let’s see who we have for today’s deliveries.
Just Yana and my mom today for letters and a package for Telu. He doesn’t usually get packages and it’s from Dalo. Interesting.
What? No. Why would you... You know what? Nevermind. Do you know anything about walking mushrooms?
Yes.
Uso, are you feeling okay?
Yana, I’m fine. I saw these little mushroom creatures yesterday in the forest.
Are you sure you’re okay?
Yes. I’m sure. They had a mailbox.
I think you’re working too much. Have some breakfast.
Walking... Mushrooms?
Good morning Yana!
Good morning, uso. What do you have for me?
Oh? Now I’m intrigued. What would you have me do? If it’s poisoning your mother, I’m not going to do that.
Just some letters and a bit of a weird request.
Breakfast. Yes. That’s what I need. If you were going to feed a walking mushroom, what would you feed it?
Well... Probably not a mushroom omelet.
Oh I don’t know, uso. Mushrooms are a fungus. They feed mostly on rotten things and I don’t keep anything rotten here.
Okay but what else would you give them?
Maybe fruit? I have these fruit tarts that I made yesterday that I was going to bring over to the school later.
Can I have two of them? I’ll pay you for them.
You can have two. You don’t need to pay me. I was going to drop them off for free to Tivona. Why don’t you just take the batch over there for me and keep two of them?
That would be great, Yana. Could you do me another big favour?
I’m still not poisoning your mother.
I... What? No. Can you wrap the two I’m keeping? Like a package?
Oh. Easy. Absolutely, uso. That way you don’t get them mixed up. Consider it done.
Thank you.
One condition.
Yes?
You eat this before it gets cold.
I have no idea where she produced this plate of eggs and potatoes from but I have never argued with Yana before and I’m not going to start today.
Yes?
Hi. Sorry for interrupting class. Yana sent me over with these for you and the kids.
Oooo. Okay. Give them here. I’ll take them in and set them on the desk. Maybe then the kids will look at the front.
You bet. I also have a small request.
What can I do for you?
Can you come to the path by Telu’s lumberyard when school is out.
Is this related to the walking mushrooms?
This is related to the walking mushrooms. Can you bring some paper and wax sticks?
Yes?
Great! I’ll see you later!
Good morning, Telu!
Good morning Opal. You back for that trail?
Yes and no. You have a package.
Me? I have a package?
Yes? Were you not expecting one?
Yeah, nah. I can’t think of anyone who would be sending me a package.
It’s from Dalo. Does that help?
No. That makes even less sense. Let me see it.
That looks like... Lyrei’s pottery. It’s damaged but her style is unmistakable.
Telu?
Someone found this in Dalo and they were trying to return it to Lyrei.
Are you okay?
Nah, yeah. I’m fine. I just... I need to go inside. Thank you, Ope. I’ll see you later.
Poor Telu. Lyrei’s been missing for the last 8 years. He is the only one still holding out any hope that she’ll come home.
I think he’s in denial. No one escapes the blight. No one has the heart to tell him. Well... No one but my mother.
Not that either of them will listen to each other. He blames her for Lyrei’s disappearance and she’s too proud to admit that he’s right.
There are... More rocks and sticks. And two leaves this time. Absolutely fascinating.
Hmm... Is... Is that rocks? And... Sticks? And a leaf. Fascinating. I’m not sure where I’ll put this but they clearly want to be part of the mail system and who am I to tell them they can’t be?
Okay... Low and slow. I got this. I can do this.
Good morning, walking mushrooms. I have mail for you.
These are from Yana, at the inn in Petrichoria. We’re the town right next to you. The one with the um… Mailboxes.
Mmmmmmmmmm!!!!
I don’t think I’ve ever seen anyone this excited for mail. Well... Maybe Rin but they’re a special case.
Those are... What... Well... That’s one way to use them.
I’m not sure what I thought would happen if I gave a bunch of creatures without mouths food but I wasn’t really expecting this.
I have a friend coming in a little bit. Do you understand that word? Friend?
Friend.
Mmmmmmmmm.
Tivona! You came!
I did say I was coming, yes. I’m not really sure about this, though.
Please. For the sake of your best friend?
Okay but only because I love you dearly and I am actually worried about your well-being.
I promise you they’re real. This way.
Oh. There really is a mailbox with feet. How odd.
I told you. Now, this part is important. We have to be slow. They spook easily.
The walking mushrooms?
The walking mushrooms.
Oh.
What... What are we doing with these?
I... Want you to teach them to write?
Your mother.
Point made.
You what?
So they can actually do... mail.
Opal... They don’t have hands.
I told you.
I know. I know. I just... Well... I thought the stress was getting to you.
Ti... We live in the quietest town on a port no one really uses in the middle of a world-wide catastrophe. What stress?
They can still pick things up and clearly they can use tools. You saw the mailbox!
I... Okay. Valid points. I will try but please set your expectations low.
Nope. You’re the best teacher I know.
I’m... The only teacher you know?
Exactly.
I’ve taught worse. They’re kind of like toddlers.
Thank you, Ti.
This was fun. Weird, but fun.
Yeah. Let’s head back to the inn before it gets dark.
I do not want to be out here in the dark.
Do you think they’ll be alright out here?
Later...
They’ve been alright out here for who knows how long. They’ll be fine, Opal.
How did your deliveries go?
They went very well. Thank you for the tarts.
Did your walking mushrooms like them?
They... Did.
Uso... What do you mean?
They didn’t... Eat them? They don’t have mouths.
The walking mushrooms don’t have mouths?
They don’t have hands either.
Oh. So it’s a group delusion.
It’s not a delusion. Look at these scribbles they did.
You kept them?
I kept a couple. At the insistence of the walking mushrooms.
Have you asked Kauma about them?
I think you should ask Kauma. If anyone knows about random creatures, it’ll be her.
Eat up, uso.
Honestly, that should have been my first stop.
Opal, you’re getting back very late. I thought I asked you to be speedier today.
Sorry, mom. Something came up with Tivona.
Did anything come for me?
Oh. Yes. You got a few letters from Dalo.
Always Dalo. Give them here. I’ll look in the morning to see if these are important.
Mom?
Yes?
Have you ever seen a walking mushroom?
Go up to bed. You’ve clearly spent too long at Yana’s tonight.
Right. Good night.
Well I guess I’ll add these to the others.
Hmm... Where to put these? This basket will do, I guess, for now.
I wonder what today will bring from the strange mushrooms. Let’s see who I have on my route today.
Just my mother. Strange, this one is from Vrezodia. I should stop in and see Kauma after breakfast, anyway.
Good morning, uso.
Good morning, Yana. I don’t have anything for you today.
That’s okay. I have things for you. Starting with breakfast.
You take such good care of me.
Someone has to. Eat up and then I need you to deliver a few meals for me.
I don’t have anyone on my route so I’m all yours.
Music to my ears.
I’m glad to hear it. Now, I need you to deliver meals to Eriato, Kauma, Saoirse, and Telu today. And you can give these to your little walking mushroom friends.
I’m on it. And thank you. I really like these little mushroom guys.
I can tell. You almost never ask me for anything, uso.
All done. It was delicious.
All done?
They’re so excited about mail. It’s the weirdest thing.
It is... Strange.
I’ll be off, then. Mom is really upset with me for staying out so late yesterday.
Your mother gets upset about everything. This isn’t really new.
I’d rather not add fuel to the fire.
Ah if it isn’t my favourite little iridescent dumpling.
You’re only saying that because you know I have food for you.
For the record, I’d have said that anyway. But yes please. Give me the food. I’m starving.
Eri... You’re in a store full of food.
That doesn’t count. It’s not cooked and, most importantly, it’s not cooked by Yana.
You’re insufferable. Take your food.
Tell me, my delectable little friend, anything of interest in your life?
You ever met a walking mushroom?
I’ve met my fair share of mushrooms, some for food and some for fun but none of them walked.
Well... I’m delivering mail for a little group of walking mushrooms.
You just live the most fascinating life.
Actually, that’s a lie and we both know it, but you know what I mean.
Do I?
Yes. I’ve decided that you do. Now go so I can eat without being observed. I’m too hungry to eat pretty.
I’m leaving. Enjoy your breakfast.
Good morning Kauma!
Hi Opal. Is that my breakfast?
Yes it is.
You spend too much time with Rin.
The longer you make me wait, the more likely I am to ask you questions while you’re working.
Okay. You win. I just need a moment to finish this up.
So...
Okay fine. I am finishing it up now.
What questions were you going to ask?
A little bit later...
Have you ever encountered a walking mushroom?
Wonderful. Could you set it down on the counter for me?
If I set it down and walk away, are you going to forget it’s there?
How about I just hold it here until you’re done?
You mean mushlings? Absolutely. I helped set up their own little home just outside of town.
Did you help them build the mailbox?
The what?
The mailbox. They have a mailbox.
No... That’s new. Tell me about this mailbox.
A little while later...
Fascinating.
Isn’t it?
So they’re advancing in their cognitive abilities. Showing an interest in the behaviours and interests of higher fey. That’s incredible.
You’ll have to share any further developments in their society with me. I’m, obviously, very busy with my research but I have time for a side study.
You do?
Limited time, but yes. This would make for a fascinating research paper.
I will keep you updated. For now, though, I should take Saoirse her food before it gets cold.
Would it get cold? Doesn’t Yana enchant them?
I’m not sure but I’m not willing to find out. Yana feeds me and I’m not risking it.
Well thank you for sharing your discoveries with me. I need to remember where I was before you interrupted.
You’re welcome. For the interruption, breakfast, and the information.
Hi Sao!
Breakfast!!!!
Well, yes, but I’m here, too.
Yes, yes but b r e a k f a s t.
Here you go, Saoirse.
Did you make a mailbox with feet?
Nnh-mmm.
Hm?
Thank you, Opal.
Saoirse...
What?
Nope.
Strange. Okay. I will leave you to your breakfast.
Telu, I have breakfast for you!
Can you just set it on the bench for me?
Mmm.
I can’t imagine how hard seeing that pottery yesterday must have been for him. I wonder if he showed it to Effie. I can’t imagine he did. She’s doing so well now.
There’s... Sticks and rocks and leaves... And fruit? And some scraps of paper. I think that’s supposed to be the inn? Fascinating.
There’s... Sticks and rocks and... Fruit? And some scraps of paper. I think that’s supposed to be the inn? How close have they gotten to town?
There’s... Fruit and pinecones and some scraps of paper. I think that’s supposed to be the inn? How close have they gotten to the town?
Mushlings? It’s Opal. The mailman.
Yana sent these to you
!!!! Mmmmmmmmmm!!!!!!!!!!!
You okay?
Mhmm. Thank you Opal. I’ll grab it when I’m done here.
Okay. I’m going to go see the mushlings.
No quips for me today?
Not today. I’m tired, Ope.
They’re actually really cute when they’re excited. Once you get past the weirdness of walking mushrooms, they’re really endearing.
My friend that came yesterday is going to come again today so she can teach you some more.
Mmm.
Later...
They’re getting better. I can almost make out what they’re trying to write.
I asked Saoirse and she said she didn’t build the mailbox.
And Kauma said they’re called Mushlings?
Mhmm. Strange little creatures, right?
I think they have the potential to be higher fey.
Kauma wants updates on their progress.
Well, they gave me some letters and drawings. You can take these two to Kauma next time you deliver to her.
I think I need to deliver these to Yana?
That’s so cute, Ope.
Yana’s going to get a kick out of this tomorrow.
Not tonight?
I need to get home early tonight, so I’ll have to skip Yana’s tonight.
Unfortunate but understandable. Want me to walk you back?
That would be great.
Mom?
In here.
You only got one letter today. It’s from Vrezodia.
What?
Fern is coming back to Petrichoria.
Vrezodia? Give it here.
Mom? What is it?
Unfinished business.
Opal
Yana
Rin
Eriato
Kauma
Diora
Telu
Mushling
Tivona
Elora
Amber
Saoirse
Inner Monolog
